**CHARACTER VARIETIES FOR SL(3, C): THE FIGURE EIGHT KNOT**

*E. FALBEL, A. GUILLOUX, P.-V. KOSELEFF*

29 pp, 25 sections.

**Abstract.** We give a description of several representation varieties of the fundamental group of the complement of the ﬁgure eight knot in PGL(3, C) or PSL(3, C). We obtain a description of the projection of the representation variety into the character variety of the boundary torus into SL(3, C).
